authorization.this_delivery: literature, sanitized control metadata, code review, protocol publication

identity.signal_family: trend/time-series-momentum; same family as prior trend; not independent discovery

signal.selection: no parameter competition; reject or retain the one joint rule; do not select a different parameter per asset
signal.decision: UTC daily close t; use only closed bars; first eligible fill at t+1 hour, never same-close fill
signal.entry: one position per asset; no pyramid; eligible on initial scoring date or direction change; after stop/time exit wait for next direction change
signal.exit: zero/opposite daily direction, fixed entry stop distance 3*ATR20, or 84 calendar days; earliest trigger; conservative intrahour stop/gap fill
signal.atr: mean of last 20 true ranges, including last closed day
signal.reversal: close first; opposite entry only at next hourly open after close

risk.drawdown: hourly marked equity against running high-water; latch reductions through fold; no restart; breach despite gap is risk failure
risk.nominal_caps_source: design, retained from old portfolio envelope
risk.C_multiplier: min(1, median(previous 252 daily sigma20 estimates)/current closed-day sigma20), per asset; reductions only for held quantity, never increase until next natural entry
risk.quantity: floor(min(stop-risk budget/stop-distance, asset cap/entry price, available shared cash after reserves/entry price)/lot_step)*lot_step; never round up to minimum
risk.shared_wallet: B/C/half-B each one 1000 USDT wallet; simultaneous orders proportional downscale then floor, BTC first only for equal residual priority; cost/funding deducted once; no combining standalone equity curves

cost.funding: actual signed event cashflow and associated mark; no default zero or proxy mark
cost.known_higher_fee: refreeze higher fee before any score; account applicable fee UNKNOWN
cost.settlement: bind existing reviewed precision and conservative cashflow consumer before native; avoid double-counting native fees/funding

train.binding: old Issue119 source registration is not this protocol registration
train.quality: BLOCKED_DATA in checked old terminal; complete current usable pool UNKNOWN

old_exposed.use: exposure disclosure only; not an extra fold or independent evidence

forward.purpose: proposed independent confirmation only after frozen candidate and dependency clearance before start
forward.dependency: do not read protected 2025, February/August 2026 BTC windows for warmup; freeze reviewed sufficient-state initialization or later calendar in a new version before observing any forward price
forward.extension: none; insufficient samples at fixed end -> UNDERPOWERED; start deadline missed -> this forward proposal lapses without retrospective registration

samples.source: new conservative design proposal, not an empirical power claim
samples.old_issue131: UNDERPOWERED unchanged; 30 old clusters not relaxed
samples.unit: merge overlapping BTC/ETH holding intervals transitively into joint natural episodes; forced exits/reductions/native chunks are not new independent events
samples.rationale: 84-day signal overlap and correlated assets invalidate trade-count independence; calendar blocks are a minimum dependence check, not proof of independence
samples.training: 730 days cannot supply 12 full blocks; may reject or generate a provisional candidate, never qualify
samples.confirmation: one preselected B primary; one-sided 95% lower bound on mean net daily wallet PnL from moving-block bootstrap, block length 84 days, 10000 replicates, seed 139; primary base and stress lower bounds >=0 without rounding; sensitivity 168-day blocks also must not turn bound negative; observed dependence beyond 84 days -> INCONCLUSIVE, not pass
samples.concentration: largest natural episode positive PnL <=25% of total positive episode PnL; report block concentration and all negative episodes
samples.controls: C improvement claim additionally requires paired block lower bound of C-minus-B >=0 and C-minus-half-B >=0 under both costs; otherwise no C advantage claim; do not switch primary from B to C after seeing data

stage_gates: supervisor reviews fixed package, resolves window/source contract, freezes acquisition budget and registration before market reads
authorized source integrity and deterministic standalone sizing/sample/cost feasibility; blocked source -> BLOCKED_DATA; no executable orders -> NO_GO_EXECUTION; zero natural events -> NO_GO_SAMPLE
at most four A native jobs; either asset negative stress net, risk failure or sizing failure -> NO_GO for this fixed two-asset experiment, no B/C/half-B jobs
only if both A pass provisional training screen, six B/C/half-B native jobs; B negative stress or risk fail -> NO_GO; no candidate substitution
only a frozen provisional B with legal forward admission may use ten forward jobs; no observation scheduling is authorized here
at forward end confidence/sample/risk failures are explicit; no extension, retune, extra fold or sealed-window substitution

native_budget.failures: any reservation/attempt charges its slot even on error; no replacement keys or unmetered jobs; old technical-retry budget is not new authorization

acquisition_budget.future_budget: UNKNOWN; source reconstruction must be resolved and bounded in subsequent fixed manifest before network calls

literature_audit.deviation: One over the limit if each open invocation counts; two final calls expanded previously opened PDF and official configuration; no further retrieval. Requires supervisor acceptance, not a compliant-budget claim.
